art_direction: Design independent shrines from Frostjaw signature trophy materials: crystalline jaw, white shaggy pelt, swept ice fin and icy core. Version 4 informs mass, material and drawing quality only; its head geometry is not locked.

artworks.name: A · 冰颚祠龛
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a BRAND-NEW 2D game building sprite: "Frost Shrine", a crafted trophy shrine for Don't Starve Together. Design the BUILDING first. It is made from the characteristic materials of an icy shark boss: a blue crystalline jaw, grey fin-shaped structural parts, white shaggy pelt, and an icy power core. Recombine the materials into a new functional object; do not depict the creature's head or body.
Direction A — ICE-JAW RELIQUARY.
A compact, squat, strongly designed ceremonial shrine with an open-front vaulted frame and a broad jaw-shaped ice offering basin:
- A thick U-shaped blue-grey crystalline jaw is repurposed as the FRONT HALF of the offering basin, with five large upward curling blade-shaped facets and one central downward-pointed tip. Distinct sharp white facet borders. This is the most recognizable trophy material, occupying the lower third.
- The main structure is TWO hefty ash-grey swept fin-shaped stone ribs rising from the sides of that basin and leaning inward to join a short angular lintel above. Clear constructed joints, bevelled slab ends, no anatomy. They form a deep roomy arch supporting the shrine; the opening has absolutely NO teeth. The exterior silhouette is slightly lopsided and handmade.
- Inside, a dark slate recessed backing and a tiny low offering shelf frame ONE small bright icy core at the visual center. Pale blue-white inner light, restrained local blue reflections, two small drawn angular cold wisps. A sacred object displayed within a shrine, readable from far away.
- A narrow strip of shaggy off-white trophy fur is visibly draped ACROSS the TOP crossbeam and hangs down a short way at its two ends, like an altar cloth. It does not surround the front as a mane or form a head.
- A single narrow backward-curving blue ice fin is fitted into a small socket BEHIND the top crossbeam as a rear finial. Shorter than the shrine opening. It visually balances the strong ice-jaw basin below.
- The whole structure rests on a low oval ash-grey foot with two short solid lateral braces. No sculpted paws.
Architectural hierarchy: chunky icy basin below, open framed niche in the middle, small pelt-draped lintel and swept ice crest above. The opening must be unmistakably an assembled alcove, not a gaping animal mouth. Keep a confident broad silhouette, strong front opening and compact mass comparable to Don't Starve's Scaled Furnace. About 1.2 times taller than wide. It should feel built from boss trophies, neither a generic stone hut nor a boss statue.
Style: native Don't Starve Together hand-inked cut-paper 2D sprite; strong irregular near-black outer contour, angular large planes, economical scratchy diagonal pen hatching, flat grey and desaturated steel-blue gouache, 2-3 hard shade values, off-white fur and sharp pale ice facet edges. No smooth rendering or elaborate concept-art detail. Maintain clarity at 128px.
View: complete building, modest elevated three-quarter game view with front and a little side/top visible. Centered on square transparent alpha canvas, about 80% height, whole base visible.
No face, skull, muzzle, forehead, eye sockets, eyes, eyebrow, nose, ears, cheeks, teeth over the opening, horns attached to a head, hands, animal body, oversized crystal castle, roofed igloo, ornate runes, gold, chains, scattered props, label, text, frame, ground, external shadow, checkerboard, photorealism or 3D render.

artworks.name: B · 寒潮供台
artworks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a BRAND-NEW native Don't Starve Together 2D game-building sprite, a "Frost Shrine" built from trophies of an icy shark boss. Deliberately design a freestanding OPEN OFFERING ALTAR rather than a head, a monster, a statue or a closed furnace. Recombine recognisable frozen jaw, fin, white pelt and core materials into a practical magical relic.
Direction B — TIDAL FROST OFFERING ALTAR.
A low, broad ceremonial altar shaped like a heavy oval basin on a short stout support, viewed at the game's elevated three-quarter angle:
- The broad front rim of the basin is a repurposed BLUE CRYSTALLINE SHARK JAW: five large blue-grey sweeping blade-shaped facets with strong chalk-white polygon edges, making an irregular upward flaring crown around the lower FRONT only. A central pointed ice chin anchors the front silhouette. Recognizable boss material but part of a crafted vessel, no face.
- Behind this jaw-rim sits an exposed chunky dark ash-grey stone bowl. The upper basin is open, with visible elliptical top plane. A luminous icy core sits on a small raised central offering seat, clearly above the rim and fully visible. One compact irregular blue-white core, 25% of the building height, a restrained glow with two simple angular cold wisps.
- Three ash-grey fin-shaped short buttresses, carved with big simple bevels, hold the bowl above a shallow oval ring footing. They splay outward like robust architectural supports, never limbs, fingers or claws. The center is solid and compact, not a tall thin goblet stem.
- At the BACK of the bowl a SINGLE large swept icy dorsal-fin fragment rises on a grey stone socket to create an asymmetrical ceremonial backplate behind the core. This backplate leans backward and slightly to one side, framing the glow while leaving it unobstructed. An intentionally asymmetrical profile, not two horns or a face.
- A short draped strip of shaggy off-white trophy pelt wraps the outside of the grey bowl BELOW its rim, with two small uneven pendant tufts between the supports. It reads as a bound trophy trim on a vessel, not the fur of a creature. Grey bowl, white pelt trim and blue crystal rim make a strong three-material rhythm.
No upper jaw or hood; the core is OPEN TO THE SKY. No head-shaped dome, muzzle, eyes, mouth facade, brow or teeth arch. This should have its own silhouette like an unusual ceremonial basin, with the ice jaw functioning as its rim and the fin as its rear backdrop. Design a cohesive crafted object, not a random pile of monster parts. Short, substantial, about as wide as tall.
Style: authentic Don't Starve Together in-game hand-drawn cut-paper object; thick lively near-black irregular contour, sparse scratchy hatching, hard-edged muted grey/steel-blue flat gouache values, a few chalk-white ice facets, offwhite coarse fur. Strong readable silhouettes, economical geometry, only 2-3 shade values. Not photorealism, glossy fantasy loot, smooth digital painting or 3D.
Composition: one complete centered isolated building at elevated 3/4 angle; all feet visible; occupies 78% of square canvas with real transparent alpha background. No text, labels, frames, ground patch, huge platform, extra offerings, gold, machinery, complex runes, symbols, big magic circle, particles, external cast shadow or checkerboard.
